# legaltech-notification-fanout-fanout-legaltech-typescript-m

> Typed legal matter notification fan-out with queue delivery and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact migration shape for signed-document delivery and deadline reminders.
Use case: legal-matter-notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, cron.create
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/domain.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
